absolute_bar.comment: Frozen promotion design needs an explicit absolute economic bar alongside baseline-beats. ALL conditions must hold on the HELD-OUT window at 1x costs; cost-stress columns are guardrails.

conditions.stress_1p5x_2x_3x: filtered beats always-take on net Sharpe at every stress level

calibration_separation: Brier/log-loss/reliability on enter+latent reported separately; NEVER mixed into efficacy or portfolio metrics.

costs.model: paper_fill_v1 two-leg adverse fills; stress multiplies spread only

created: BEFORE any S5 comparison is computed; results commit separately.
holdout: Final time segment from time_splits (never used for selection; selection code cannot import it).
leakage_guards: stream built first from bars[..i] only
walk-forward with purge of boundary-overlapping labels + embargo gap
no JEV-derived label in the JEV decision

method.calibration: Brier on CLOSED labels only; censored excluded, counted separately
method.efficacy_primary: candidate-level paired delta mean (filtered_R - always_R) with stationary-bootstrap 95% CI
method.holm: step-down alpha 0.05, one pooled family over declared variants
method.portfolio: daily returns incl. zero-days, Sharpe xsqrt(252), Newey-West HAC SE
method.search_correction: Holm over the union of declared variants

policies.ALWAYS_TAKE: take every realized candidate at frozen economics
policies.JEV_FILTERED: v4 evaluate; take only PASS_BASE/PASS_ELEVATED_ELIGIBLE; HOLD never fills

search_budget.note: v4 table itself is FROZEN; variants are pre-declared answer-threshold readings only, evaluated on the same window; Holm pools them.

window.definition: synthetic deterministic stream (harness proof) + S2 validation slice (pipeline proof); stub answers ONLY - no JEV-value claim until live-provider answers are evaluated under this same protocol
window.labels: win/loss resolved by frozen economics; censored preserved, excluded from Brier
